thread:
Priya: FYI starting hammerhead-9b onboard today. I uploaded weights but hit a tokenizer quirk in local smoke runs — BOS token duplicated in some prompts. Can someone confirm weights path and config?
Sasha: path pls
Priya: s3://redwood-models/hammerhead-9b/release/v1/weights.tar.gz
Priya: manifest at s3://redwood-models/hammerhead-9b/release/v1/manifest.json
Dan: quick glance — manifest.vocab_type says `sentencepiece` but the archive contains byte-level BPE artifacts. That mismatch will cause BOS/CLS duplication. Can you paste tokenizer.json header?
Priya: pasted snippet:
```
{
  "tokenizer_type": "sentencepiece",
  "model": "model.spm",
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>"
}
```
Dan: ok that's the problem — the bundle actually has `vocab.bpe` + merges. Somebody rebuilt tokenizer incorrectly. Replace tokenizer with `tokenizer_orig/` from training artifacts. I can patch manifest if you want.
Priya: please patch, that would save time. Also note perf smoke: `rbt bench --model hammerhead-9b --batch 16 --seq 512` spikes GPU memory and fails at step ~3 with OOM.
Emma: run quick sanity with smaller batch and kv-cache disabled to isolate:
```
rbt bench --model hammerhead-9b --batch 8 --seq 512 --kv-cache off --runs 5
```
Emma: if that runs ok we know it's batch/KV interplay
Dan: reproduced OOM at batch 16 on 80GB A100. Batch 8 stable. Memory growth looks like KV cache not being truncated due to incorrect `max_sequence_length` in model config (was set to 4096 but weights were exported for 2048).
Sasha: where's model config in bundle?
Priya: model/config.json inside tar. Paste relevant fields:
```
{
  "hidden_size": 4096,
  "max_sequence_length": 4096,
  "num_heads": 32
}
```
Dan: set `max_sequence_length` to 2048 in patched config and try again. Also adjust serving config `prefill_max_len` to 2048 in catalog entry.
Priya: ok I'll patch and re-run smoke.
Infra-bot: perf-job 68321 started by priya — https://ci.redwood/p/68321 (bench harness)
Emma: tokenizer edge-case note — some training prompts included explicit <s> token learned into vocab position 1; using sentencepiece header with bpe files maps bytes differently. Restoring original spm fixes duplication.
Sasha: while patching, add `tokenizer_checksum` to catalog metadata so validations catch mismatches.
Priya: added checklist items and updating `catalog/hammerhead-9b/serve.yaml`:
```
model_path: s3://redwood-models/hammerhead-9b/release/v1/weights.tar.gz
tokenizer_type: sentencepiece
tokenizer_path: s3://redwood-models/hammerhead-9b/release/v1/tokenizer.model
max_sequence_length: 2048
recommended_batch_sizes: [1,2,4,8]
```
Dan: when you push catalog changes, include a small perf matrix CSV (batch,seq,throughput,latency_p95_ms). Example:
```
batch,seq,throughput,latency_p95_ms
8,512,118,45
4,1024,64,80
```
Priya: will upload CSV to s3://redwood-models/hammerhead-9b/release/v1/perf/smoke.csv
Emma: note in catalog that runtime >= 2.4.1 required for kv pruning for max_sequence_length > 2048 (link to release notes).
Dan: I'll run bench-sweep on a dedicated node for batches 1,2,4,8 and seq 256/512/1024 and post full results.
Sasha: QA wants tokenization smoke tests for edge prompts (leading <s>, trailing whitespace, long prefix). Can someone add tests to the onboarding checklist?
Priya: done — added checkboxes in model PR and onboarding doc. Infra-bot: perf-job 68321 completed: status=success, artifact=s3://ci-artifacts/68321/bench-results.json
Dan: initial numbers look good — batch 8 / seq 512 stable at ~118 tok/s, p95 ~45ms. OOM fixed after config change. Opening PR to update catalog + manifest.
Priya: follow-ups: 1) merge PR with tokenizer fix + checksum, 2) upload perf CSV, 3) update catalog serve.yaml, 4) QA tokenization tests. Ping me for keys/paths. :thumbsup:
Sasha: I'll take QA tests. Dan — will you review PR later today?
Dan: yep, on it :eyes:
Priya: tagging @oncall-ml in PR for quick deploy window tomorrow 09:30 PT if no blockers.
